page.notes: Entry 26: the macron over the "a" in "profligānda" is doubtful. Entry 16: the page number "75" has an extra mark beside it. Entry 30 is cut off at the foot of the page, so its title is incomplete. Entry 15 prints "infideant", which is kept as printed. Long s is transcribed as plain s; s in "fensus", "silente" and "si-milaris" became s. The page number "61" was printed as "6ı".
